Batch scrape with aggressive preprocessing configuration

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'content' => { 'preprocessing_preset' => 'aggressive' } }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
urls = ['https://example.com/article1', 'https://example.com/article2']
result = Crawlberg.batch_scrape(engine, urls)
puts result.completed_count.inspect
puts result.failed_count.inspect
puts result.total_count.inspect
```
